rules.name: GracefulFallback
rules.description: If Socraticode MCP is unavailable or fails, adapter must seamlessly fallback to VaultEmbeddingIndex and report DEGRADED.

rules.name: NoCrashPolicy
rules.description: Adapter must never throw unhandled exceptions from MCP gateway interactions.

rules.name: NormalizedResponse
rules.description: Responses from both MCP and fallback must be normalized into a standard shape containing query, status, and results.
